books_reviewed.book: Generative AI Professional Prompt Engineering Guide
Generative AI Prompt Engineering Learning Ecosystem

reading_evidence.note: Review uses verified public anchors recorded in the repository catalog.

item_reviews.title: Android CLI turns device access into reusable agent skills
item_reviews.reader_value: A reusable device skill becomes more dependable when its inputs, permissions and outputs form a clear contract, its context is checked, the right prompt pattern is chosen and the result can be reused as an editable template.

item_reviews.title: When an agent says it is done, grade the database
item_reviews.reader_value: Durable-state grading helps readers distinguish a confident answer from a completed job, monitor regressions, define explicit evaluation criteria and turn verification into a repeatable workflow.

item_reviews.title: Workspace turns prompts into images, canvases and cross-app work
item_reviews.reader_value: Cross-app work is easier to trust when current facts travel with the task, prompts use a consistent structure and the generated artifact remains editable and reusable.

item_reviews.title: AstaBrief opens a faster path to citation-grounded reports
item_reviews.reader_value: Citation-grounded reports improve when retrieval combines semantic and exact matching, the research question is defined first, evidence requirements are explicit and readers practice checking what each citation really supports.

item_reviews.title: Copilot moves from chat into desktop computer use
item_reviews.reader_value: Desktop action raises the stakes: readers benefit from visible audit trails, privacy-aware context, clarification before consequential clicks and a clear division of responsibility between person and agent.

item_reviews.title: Ambient agents wake on events and know when to ask a human
item_reviews.reader_value: Event-driven autonomy becomes safer when failure handling, escalation playbooks, clarification rules and human-versus-agent roles are decided before an agent acts.
